FIELDS.NAME: Fresh & Clean Laundry Services
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Self-service laundromats require an on-site attendant for inspections.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Fresh & Clean Laundry Services, we operate a full-service laundry facility aimed at providing efficient and high-quality laundry solutions to our customers. Our operations involve both drop-off and pick-up laundry services, which ensures convenience for our clients. Our dedicated on-site staff supervises all activities, which helps maintain a safe and secure environment, mitigating risks associated with unattended, coin-operated laundromats. We adhere strictly to all relevant local, state, and federal environmental regulations, ensuring our practices are safe and compliant. We also feature modern, eco-friendly equipment to minimize our environmental impact, prioritizing customer satisfaction and safety while delivering reliable laundry services.

Our laundromat offers self-service, coin-operated washing and drying machines that customers can use to clean their laundry at their convenience, alongside our attended services for those who prefer assistance.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Self-service laundromats without on-site attendants operating concurrently with Fresh & Clean Laundry Services.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: "On 05/10/2023, we experienced a theft incident at our location where approximately $2,000 worth of laundry equipment was stolen. The incident was reported to local authorities, and we have since enhanced our security measures. The claim is currently in progress with the insurance provider."
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Safe or Vault Class: Class X, Grade: 1, Label: UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: On-site security personnel during operational hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services does not engage in activities involving the storage, treatment, discharging, application, disposal, or transportation of hazardous materials. Our operations strictly adhere to all relevant environmental regulations to ensure safety and compliance.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services does not sponsor athletic teams as part of our business operations. Our focus remains on providing high-quality laundry services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this is necessary for risk transfer. The on-site attendants check the certificates to ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or related crimes in connection with this or any other property. All business operations comply with the relevant regulations and ethical standards.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services has not had any policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. All insurance matters have been handled appropriately and in compliance with regulations.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services does not lease employees to or from other employers, ensuring full control over staffing and operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services does not carry Workers' Compensation for its self-service laundromats, as they are restricted operations. However, our full-service laundry facility does have on-site attendants and complies with all legal insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services operates a full-service laundry facility and also owns self-service laundromats without on-site attendants, which are restricted due to the associated risks.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All operations are in compliance with the relevant regulations and requirements.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on providing laundry services with on-site supervision.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services does not rent or loan equipment to others, as this operation is restricted for self-service attended laundromats due to the elevated risks involved.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, ensuring strong financial stability for our operations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Coin-operated laundries and dry cleaners (self-service attended) are restricted due to higher risks associated with property damage, theft, and liability from limited supervision.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Coin-operated laundries and self-service operations are restricted due to higher risks associated with property damage, theft, and liability from limited supervision, thus they are not eligible for coverage.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain a strong commitment to safety and compliance in all aspects of our operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh & Clean Laundry Services does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. We ensure compliance with all fire safety regulations and conduct regular inspections to maintain safety standards.
